views.name: focused_whole_view
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.name_first,
  p.name_last,
  SUM(bp.g) AS total_games,
  SUM(bp.r) AS total_runs,
  SUM(bp.h) AS total_hits,
  SUM(bp.hr) AS total_hr
FROM player AS p
JOIN batting_postseason AS bp
  ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
GROUP BY
  p.player_id,
  p.name_first,
  p.name_last
ORDER BY
  total_games DESC
LIMIT 1
views.description:
Task: Identify the baseball players with the maximum combined values of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, along with their respective scores.
Required outputs: A list of baseball player names;
